# polaris_catalog_roles (Data Source)

Lists the roles of a Polaris catalog, including the built-in `catalog_admin` role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_catalog_roles" "lakehouse" {
  catalog = "lakehouse"
}

output "lakehouse_roles" {
  value = data.polaris_catalog_roles.lakehouse.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog.

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Names of the catalog roles, in the order returned by Polaris.
- `roles` (Attributes List) The catalog roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Version of the catalog role object, used for optimistic concurrency control.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `name` (String) The name of the catalog role.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value metadata attached to the catalog role.
